name: print-social-english-school-project-slide-with-y2k-feed-grid
title: Project slide for a Y2K spy-themed English school feed with heart pixel icon
whatItIs: A cream slide with tiny top labels, a huge heavy brown title 'english school', paragraphs with bold lead-ins about a spy-mission Y2K vibe, a pixel heart, and a boxed 3x3 feed grid of colourful posts with a script 'project 5' sticker over its corner.
whatItMeans: Warm, clear and playful; the plain layout lets the vivid feed take the spotlight.
techniques: Pair a huge bold title with two short paragraphs.
Show the feed as a bordered 3x3 image.
Overlap a script sticker on the image corner.
Add a pixel heart as a small icon.

vocabulary.definition: An image of a 3x3 profile grid.
A script label over the corner of an image.
A bold phrase opening each paragraph.
A small icon drawn with visible pixels.
